exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Only/Just [noun]".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
Noun ばかり (〜bakari)

exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Noun ばかり (〜bakari).
exercises.explanation: Expresses that there is nothing but or only a certain noun.
